preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(0 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) and M (0 ≤ M ≤ 10^5), where N is the number of tasks and M is the number of dependencies.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == M + 2 and all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2]) and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: The input has exactly M + 2 lines: the first line with N and M, the second line with N integers (0 or 1) representing task execution constraints, and M lines with two integers each representing dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(e in {0, 1} for e in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].split()))
preconditions.description: Each of the N integers in the second line is either 0 (main processor) or 1 (coprocessor).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(t1) < int(t2) < N for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] for t1, t2 in [line.split()] if int(t1) != int(t2))
preconditions.description: Each dependency (T1, T2) has distinct tasks T1 ≠ T2, and all tasks are indexed from 0 to N-1.

preconditions.expression: not any((t1, t2) in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]] for t1, t2 in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]] if t1 == t2)
preconditions.description: No task depends on itself (T1 ≠ T2).

preconditions.expression: not any((t1, t2) in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]] for t1, t2 in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]] if t1 == t2 or (t2, t1) in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:]])
preconditions.description: The dependency graph is a directed acyclic graph (no circular dependencies).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimal number of coprocessor calls required to execute all tasks.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[0]) < N and 0 <= int(line.split()[1]) < N for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
postconditions.description: The output integer is derived from a valid dependency graph and coprocessor constraints.

postconditions.expression: all(int(e) == 1 for e in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].split()) if int(e) == 1) and all(int(e) == 0 for e in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].split()) if int(e) == 0)
postconditions.description: The output integer is the minimal number of coprocessor calls needed to execute all coprocessor tasks (E_i = 1) such that for each call, all dependencies of tasks in the call are either already completed or included in the same call.

postconditions.expression: all(int(e) == 0 for e in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].split()) if int(e) == 0) or (all(int(e) == 1 for e in map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1].split()) if int(e) == 1) and int(stdout.strip()) == 1)
postconditions.description: If there are no coprocessor tasks (all E_i = 0), the output is 0. If all tasks are coprocessor tasks (all E_i = 1), the output is 1.
